title: _workflow
description: A named definition of a workflow, made of an array of entries. The engine uses it to enforce, in code, what the endpoint may return for an event: every workflow event must fit an entry. The installation also builds the Claude Code workflow from it (at the location Claude Code expects by convention, like _role). Draft v0: `input` is not defined yet.

name.description: Name of the definition, e.g. "requirements intake workflow".

entries.description: May be omitted on input; normalization sets it to [].

trigger.description: The topic this entry reacts to, like _subscription.topic. The engine picks the entry whose trigger is the topic of the event it published.

output.description: The workflow events this entry allows, by topic. `fields` lists the fields an event may change; null allows any. A workflow event that fits none of them is rejected.

assignTo.description: When set, the assignee of the tasks that workflow events create or update must be this role.
